pages.title: Our History
pages.text_en:
Background of Hai District Council
Hai District Council was established from the former Moshi District in 1975 under the provisions of the Local Government (District Authorities) Act of 1982. The district is administratively subdivided into three Divisions: Lyamungo, Machame, and Masama. It comprises 17 Wards, 62 Villages, and 294 Hamlets. Politically, it is a multi-party district where all registered political parties freely operate.
pages.text_sw:
Historia ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Hai
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Hai ilianzishwa mwaka 1975 baada ya kutenganishwa na iliyokuwa Wilaya ya Moshi, kwa mujibu wa masharti ya Sheria ya Serikali za Mitaa (Mamlaka za Wilaya) ya mwaka 1982.
Kiutawala, wilaya imegawanywa katika Tarafa tatu ambazo ni Lyamungo, Machame na Masama.
Wilaya ina jumla ya Kata 17, Vijiji 62 na Vitongoji 294.
Kisiasa, Wilaya ya Hai inaendeshwa kwa mfumo wa vyama vingi vya siasa ambapo vyama vyote vya siasa vilivyosajiliwa vinafanya shughuli zake kwa uhuru kwa mujibu wa sheria.

pages.menu_path: About Us > Vision and Mission > Vision and Mission
pages.title: Vision and Mission
pages.text_en:
Vision
To be a leading Council with a robust, diversified economy that delivers high-quality, inclusive, and sustainable social services for all people of Hai District by 2031.
Mission
To foster sustainable socio-economic development and improve the quality of life for the people of Hai District through effective, efficient, and accountable public service delivery, in partnership with stakeholders and in harmony with national priorities.
pages.text_sw:
Dira
Kuwa Halmashauri inayoongoza yenye uchumi imara na ulioboreshwa katika sekta mbalimbali, inayotoa huduma bora za kijamii zilizo jumuishi na endelevu kwa watu wote wa Wilaya ya Hai ifikapo mwaka 2031.
Dhima
Kukuza maendeleo endelevu ya kijamii na kiuchumi na kuboresha ubora wa maisha ya watu wa Wilaya ya Hai kupitia utoaji wa huduma za umma zilizo na ufanisi, tija na uwajibikaji, kwa kushirikiana na wadau mbalimbali na kwa kuzingatia vipaumbele vya kitaifa.

pages.menu_path: About Us > Core Value > Core Value
pages.title: Core Values
pages.text_en:
Core Values
The following core values shall guide the conduct, decisions, and culture of Hai District Council in fulfilling its mission:
· Integrity: We uphold honesty, transparency, and ethical conduct in all our actions to build and maintain public trust.
· Accountability: We take responsibility for our decisions, actions, and results, ensuring stewardship of public resources and responsiveness to citizens.
· Customer Focus: We prioritize the needs and expectations of our community, striving to deliver timely, accessible, and quality services.
· Team Spirit: We foster collaboration, mutual respect, and shared purpose within the Council and with our partners to achieve common goals.
· Diligence: We commit to dedication, thoroughness, and continuous improvement in service delivery and performance.
· Participation: We encourage and value inclusive engagement of citizens, stakeholders, and staff in planning, implementation, and oversight.
· Courtesy: We treat all individuals with respect, professionalism, and dignity in every interaction.
pages.text_sw:
Maadili ya Msingi
Maadili yafuatayo yataongoza mwenendo, maamuzi na utamaduni wa Hai District Council katika kutekeleza dhima yake:
Uadilifu: Tunazingatia uaminifu, uwazi na maadili mema katika matendo yetu yote ili kujenga na kudumisha imani ya umma.
Uwajibikaji: Tunawajibika kwa maamuzi, matendo na matokeo yetu, tukihakikisha usimamizi mzuri wa rasilimali za umma na kuwajibika kwa wananchi.
Kumjali Mteja: Tunaweka kipaumbele kwa mahitaji na matarajio ya jamii yetu, tukijitahidi kutoa huduma kwa wakati, zenye kufikika kwa urahisi na zenye ubora.
Ushirikiano (Roho ya Timu): Tunakuza ushirikiano, kuheshimiana na mshikamano ndani ya Halmashauri na kwa washirika wetu ili kufikia malengo ya pamoja.
Bidii: Tunajizatiti kwa kujitoa, umakini na kuboresha utendaji na utoaji wa huduma kwa kuendelea.
Ushirikishwaji: Tunahamasisha na kuthamini ushiriki jumuishi wa wananchi, wadau na watumishi katika kupanga, kutekeleza na kufuatilia shughuli za maendeleo.
Ustaarabu: Tunawaheshimu watu wote kwa weledi, heshima na utu katika kila mawasiliano na mwingiliano.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Divisions > Administration and Human Resource Management
pages.title: Administration and Human Resource Management
pages.text_en:
The Administration and Human Resources Division is responsible for ensuring that all employment laws, procedures, and regulations are followed in order to maintain good governance and provide quality services to the people of Hai.
Administratively, the Hai District Council is led by the Executive Director . At the ward level, all ward responsibilities are overseen by the Ward Executive Officer , who is responsible for maintaining security, peace, and safety in the ward, as well as managing all administrative activities within the ward.
At the village level, the responsibility for maintaining peace and security lies with the Village Executive Officer , who also oversees all administrative activities within the village.
Services Provided by the Division
The main responsibility of the Administration and Human Resources Department is to oversee all administrative activities within the Council. For example, ensuring that all statutory meetings from the village level up to the council level are conducted on time and in accordance with established rules and procedures.
Providing administrative advice to the Executive Director on various administrative matters.
Ensuring that all rights and benefits of employees are met, such as timely payment of salaries, leave entitlements, and other employee rights at the workplace.
Interpreting policies, laws, regulations, and organizational structures related to employees and coordinating their implementation.
Ensuring good relationships and cooperation among employees in the workplace.
Ensuring that employees who have reached the end of their service for various reasons are removed from the payroll through the LAWSON system .
Managing disciplinary matters for all employees in collaboration with Heads of Departments.
Ensuring that the Council has adequate staff according to the staffing structure of each department, and overseeing the overall staff training program for Council employees.
Ensuring that employees are confirmed in their positions and promoted on time.
Managing Council assets and ensuring they are used properly, such as vehicles, offices, and equipment.
Preparing the salary budget and wage estimates for employees of Hai District .
Ensuring that employees work in a good working environment and are provided with the necessary tools and equipment, which are properly used and maintained in order to ensure quality service delivery to clients.
Achievements
The department has made efforts to improve employee performance by providing both internal and external training .
The Council has successfully increased the number of employees according to the allocations provided by the government and in line with staffing needs for the respective year.
pages.text_sw:
Divisheni ya utawala na utumishi ina jukumu la kuhakikisha kuwa sheria, taratibu na kanuni zote za kiutumishi zinafuatwa ili kuweza kudumisha utawala bora na utoaji huduma nzuri kwa jamii ya HAI.
Kiutawala halmashauri ya HAI inaongozwa na Mkurugenzi Mtendaji. Katika ngazi ya kata anayesimamia majukumu yote ya kata ni Afisa mtendaji kata hivyo ana jukumu la kusimamia ulinzi, amani na usalama katika kata pamoja na shughuli zote za kiutawala ndani ya kata. Katika ngazi ya vijiji, mwenye jukumu la kusimamia amani na ulinzi katika kijiji ni Mtendaji wa kijiji pamoja na shughuli zote za kiutawala ndani ya kijiji.
Huduma zinazotolewa na Divisheni
Ø Kazi kubwa katika idara ya utawala na utumishi ni kusimamia shughuli zote za kiutawala ndani ya Halmashauri mfano kuhakikisha vikao vyote vya kisheria kuanzia ngazi ya kijiji mpaka halmashauri vinafanyika kwa wakati kwa kufuata kanuni na taratibu za vikao.
Ø Kutoa ushauri kwa Mkurugenzi Mtendaji kuhusu maswala ya kiutawala
Ø Kuhakikisha haki na stahiki zote za watumishi zinapatikana mfano watumishi wanapata mishahara yao kwa wakati, likizo kwa watumishi na haki zote za mtumishi mahalapa kazi.
Ø Kutafsiri sera, sheria na kanuni pamoja na miundo zinazohusu watumishi na kuratibu utekelezaji wake.
Kuhakisha kuna mahusiano mazuri pamoja na ushirikiano kati ya mtumishi na mtumishi mahala pakazi.
Kuhakikisha watumishi wote ambao muda wao umefikia ukomo kwa sababu mbali mbali wanaondolewa katika payroll kupitia mfumo wa LAWSON.
Kusimamia masuala ya nidhamu kwa watumishi wote kwa kushirikiana na Wakuu wa Idara.
Ø Kuhakikisha halmashauri inakuwa na watumishi wa kutosha kulingana na ikama ya kila idara, pia inasimamia mpango mzima wa mafunzo kwa watumishi wa Halmashauri.
Ø Kusimamia swala zima la watumishi kuwa wanathibitishwa na kupandishwa vyeo kwa wakati.
Ø Kusimamia mali za halmashauri na kuhakikisha zinatumika vizuri mfano magari, ofisi na mitambo.
Ø Kuandaa bajeti na makisio ya mishahara kwa watumishi wa wilaya HAI
Ø Pia kuhakikisha watumishi wanafanya kazi katika mazingira mazuri ya kazi na kuwapatia vitendea kazi vinavyohitajika na vitumike vizuri pamoja na kuhifadhiwa vizuri ili kudumisha huduma nzuri kwa wateja .
Mafanikio
Ø Idara imefanya juhudi za kuhakisha watumishi wanaongeza ufanisi katika utendaji kazi kwa kuwapatia mafunzo ya ndani na ya nje ya ofisi
Ø Halmashauri imefanikiwa kuongeza watumishi kwa kadri serikali ilivyotupangia pia kulingana na mahitaji ya watumishi kwa mwaka husika.

pages.title: Pre Primary and Primary Education
pages.text_en:
DIVISION OF EARLY AND PRIMARY EDUCATION
Objective:
To plan and manage the implementation of policies and programs related to the provision of early childhood education, primary education, special needs education, adult education, and non-formal education.
Responsibilities:
This Division carries out the following responsibilities:
Planning the availability, distribution, and utilization of resources in primary schools.
Supervising the management of continuous assessment and national examinations in primary schools.
Managing the provision of adult education and non-formal education at early childhood and primary education levels.
Coordinating life skills education in primary schools.
Conducting needs assessments for special needs education, adult education, and non-formal education.
Advising on the establishment and development of centers for special needs education, adult education, and non-formal education.
Monitoring the implementation of primary education programs and plans.
Coordinating and managing sports and recreational activities in primary schools.
The Division is headed by the Division Manager and has four sections:
Academic Section
Statistics and Resources Section
Special Needs Education Section
Adult and Non-Formal Education Section
Academic Section
This section performs the following activities:
Coordinating the implementation of policies, plans, guidelines, and programs for early childhood and primary education at the school level.
Coordinating and managing continuous school assessments and national examinations for Standard Four and Standard Seven.
Supervising and evaluating the implementation of early childhood and primary education programs.
Preparing reports on the implementation of education development programs.
Coordinating the provision of self-reliance education and managing income-generating projects in primary schools.
Statistics and Resources Section
This section performs the following activities:
Collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data for early childhood and primary education.
Coordinating the availability, distribution, and utilization of educational resources in primary schools.
Managing school registration data and related resources.
Preparing reports on the progress of education development.
Identifying resource needs for schools within the Council.
Special Needs Education Section
This section performs the following activities:
Preparing and managing the implementation of special needs education programs in primary schools.
Identifying children with special needs and allocating them to appropriate schools.
Collecting data on students with special needs and providing relevant guidance.
Coordinating the availability, distribution, and utilization of special needs education resources.
Adult and Non-Formal Education Section
This section performs the following activities:
Preparing and managing the implementation of adult and non-formal education programs in primary schools.
Coordinating life skills education.
Conducting needs assessments for adult and non-formal education.
Advising on the establishment and development of adult and non-formal education training centers.
Coordinating the availability, distribution, and utilization of resources for adult and non-formal education.

pages.title: Secondary Education
pages.text_en:
The responsibilities of the Secondary Education Division in Hai District Council are as follows:
Representing the Ministry of Education, Science, and Technology within the Council.
Interpreting and overseeing the implementation of the National Education Policy and the Secondary Education Curriculum at both lower and upper levels in secondary schools within the Council.
Managing the administrative and operational activities of secondary schools.
Planning and managing development plans and budgets for Secondary Education.
Supervising and evaluating academic progress in schools by ensuring that essential teaching and learning resources are available in collaboration with the local community.
Managing the discipline of teachers, non-teaching staff, and students in secondary schools.
Overseeing the improvement of infrastructure for the delivery of secondary education services.
Advising the Council’s Chief Executive Officer on matters related to Secondary Education.

Majukumu ya Divisheni ya Elimu Sekondari katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Hai ni kama ifuatavyo:-
Kuiwakilisha Wizara ya Elimu, Sayansi na Teknolojia katika Halmashauri.
Kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa Sera ya Taifa ya Elimu na Mtaala wa Elimu Sekondari hatua ya chini na hatua ya juu katika shule za Sekondari zilizopo ndani ya Halmashauri
Kusimamia shughuli za utawala na uendeshaji wa shule za sekondari.
Kupanga na kusimamia mipango na bajeti ya maendeleo ya Elimu Sekondari
Kusimamia na kutoa tathimini ya maendeleo ya taaluma ya Shule kwa kuhakikisha mahitaji muhimu ya kufundishia na kujifunzia yanapatikana kwa kushirikiana na jamii katika maeneo husika.
Kusimamia nidhamu ya walimu, watumishi wasio walimu na wanafunzi wa shule za sekondari
Kusimamia uboreshaji wa miundo mbinu ya kutolea huduma ya elimu ya sekondari
Kusmshauri Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Halmashauri kuhusu masuala ya Elimu Sekondari

pages.title: Community Development
pages.text_en:
The Department of Community Development is one of the important departments within the Council responsible for promoting social and economic development among citizens. The department aims to empower community members to actively participate in development activities, strengthen community welfare, and reduce poverty through various development programs and projects.
The Department of Community Development works in collaboration with different community groups such as women, youth, children, the elderly, and people with disabilities to ensure they have equal opportunities to participate in development and benefit from services provided by the government and development partners.
Responsibilities of the Department of Community Development
Mobilizing and educating citizens to participate in social and economic development activities.
Coordinating and supervising social and economic groups such as women’s groups, youth groups, and groups of people with disabilities .
Providing community development education including issues of gender equality, good parenting, and family welfare .
Supervising and monitoring the implementation of community development plans and projects within the Council.
Coordinating the provision of 10% of the Council’s internal revenue loans allocated to women, youth, and people with disabilities.
Protecting and promoting the rights and welfare of children, the elderly, and special groups within the community.
Collaborating with government and non-governmental institutions in implementing community development programs.
Conducting research and collecting information related to the status of community development to support planning for development programs.
pages.text_sw:
Idara ya Maendeleo ya Jamii ni mojawapo ya idara muhimu katika Halmashauri inayohusika na kuhamasisha maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi kwa wananchi. Idara hii inalenga kuwawezesha wananchi kushiriki kikamilifu katika shughuli za maendeleo, kuimarisha ustawi wa jamii na kupunguza umaskini kupitia mipango na miradi mbalimbali ya maendeleo.
Idara ya Maendeleo ya Jamii hufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana na makundi mbalimbali ya jamii kama vile wanawake, vijana, watoto, wazee na watu wenye ulemavu ili kuhakikisha wanapata fursa sawa za kushiriki katika maendeleo na kunufaika na huduma zinazotolewa na serikali pamoja na wadau wa maendeleo.
Majukumu ya Idara ya Maendeleo ya Jamii ni pamoja na:
Kuhamasisha na kuelimisha wananchi kushiriki katika shughuli za maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi.
Kuratibu na kusimamia vikundi vya kijamii na kiuchumi kama vile vikundi vya wanawake, vijana na watu wenye ulemavu.
Kutoa elimu ya maendeleo ya jamii ikiwemo masuala ya usawa wa kijinsia, malezi bora na ustawi wa familia.
Kusimamia na kufuatilia utekelezaji wa mipango na miradi ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Halmashauri.
Kuratibu utoaji wa mikopo ya asilimia 10 (10%) ya mapato ya ndani ya Halmashauri kwa wanawake, vijana na watu wenye ulemavu.
Kulinda na kuendeleza haki na ustawi wa watoto, wazee na makundi maalum katika jamii.
Kushirikiana na taasisi za serikali na zisizo za kiserikali katika kutekeleza programu za maendeleo ya jamii.
Kufanya tafiti na kukusanya taarifa zinazohusu hali ya maendeleo ya jamii ili kusaidia kupanga mipango ya maendeleo.

pages.title: Health, Social Welfare and Nutrition
pages.text_en:
The responsibilities of the Department of Health, Community Development, and Nutrition are aimed at improving the well-being of citizens through quality health services, community empowerment, and improved nutrition. The main responsibilities include overseeing health policies, strengthening maternal and child health services, providing nutrition education, preventing epidemic diseases, and promoting economic and social development.
Main Responsibilities in Health and Well-being:
Health Services: Overseeing health centers, dispensaries, and hospitals to ensure access to quality medical care.
Disease Prevention: Coordinating vaccination campaigns, community health education, and control of communicable and non-communicable diseases (such as HIV/AIDS and heart diseases).
Nutrition Management: Educating communities on proper nutrition, especially for children under two years and pregnant women, and addressing malnutrition.
Health Insurance: Supervising the implementation of Universal Health Insurance policies to improve citizens’ access to services.
Community Development Responsibilities:
Empowerment: Supporting social groups (women, youth, and the elderly) economically through training and microloans.
Social Welfare: Protecting the rights of children, the elderly, and people with disabilities from abuse and neglect.
Environmental Sanitation: Encouraging communities to maintain environmental cleanliness to prevent disease outbreaks.
Anti-Corruption Efforts: Educating the public to avoid corrupt practices that hinder development.
Coordination of Stakeholders and Data:
Overseeing and monitoring the implementation of health and development projects.
Managing databases and statistics related to health, social welfare, and nutrition.
pages.text_sw:
Majukumu ya Idara ya Afya, Maendeleo ya Jamii, na Lishe yanalenga kuboresha ustawi wa wananchi kupitia huduma bora za afya, uwezeshaji wa jamii, na kuboresha lishe. Majukumu makuu ni pamoja na kusimamia sera za afya, kuimarisha huduma za mama na mtoto, kutoa elimu ya lishe, kuzuia magonjwa ya mlipuko, na kuwezesha maendeleo ya kiuchumi na kijamii.
Majukumu Makuu ya Afya na Ustawi:
· Huduma za Afya: Kusimamia vituo vya afya, zahanati, na hospitali ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa matibabu bora.
· Kuzuia Magonjwa: Kuratibu kampeni za chanjo, elimu ya afya ya jamii, na udhibiti wa magonjwa ya kuambukiza na yasiyoambukiza (kama UKIMWI na magonjwa ya moyo).
· Usimamizi wa Lishe: Kuelimisha jamii kuhusu lishe bora, hasa kwa watoto chini ya miaka miwili na mama wajawazito, na kudhibiti utapiamlo.
· Bima ya Afya: Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera ya Bima ya Afya kwa Wote ili kuongeza uwezo wa wananchi kupata huduma.
Majukumu ya Maendeleo ya Jamii:
· Uwezeshaji: Kuwezesha vikundi vya kijamii (wanawake, vijana, wazee) kiuchumi kupitia mafunzo na mikopo.
· Ustawi wa Jamii: Kulinda haki za watoto, wazee, na watu wenye ulemavu dhidi ya unyanyasaji na kutelekezwa.
· Usafi wa Mazingira: Kuhamasisha jamii kuzingatia usafi wa mazingira ili kuzuia magonjwa ya mlipuko.
· Mapambano dhidi ya Rushwa: Kuelimisha jamii kuacha vitendo vya rushwa vinavyochelewesha maendeleo.
Kuratibu Wadau na Takwimu:
· Kusimamia na kufuatilia utekelezaji wa miradi ya afya na maendeleo.
· Kusimamia kanzidata na takwimu za afya, ustawi wa jamii, na lishe.

pages.title: Infrastructure and Rural and Urban Development
pages.text_en:
The Division of Infrastructure, Rural and Urban Development is responsible for managing and providing advice on all matters related to infrastructure development in the Council.
Its main responsibilities include:
i. Managing the implementation of policies, laws, and procedures related to the construction and infrastructure sector.
ii. Planning and coordinating infrastructure development in the Council.
iii. Conducting assessments and providing recommendations on contractor payment claims.
iv. Inspecting construction projects to ensure work quality is observed.
v. Issuing completion certificates for construction projects in accordance with contracts.
vi. Managing the construction and maintenance of roads in collaboration with TARURA.
vii. Managing the development of rural and urban housing.
viii. Participating in the resolution of land use conflicts.
ix. Managing the process of urban growth and sustainable housing development.
Separation of Responsibilities
This division is divided into three main sections which perform different functions, which are: Construction Section
i. Manage construction projects of government buildings and other infrastructure.
ii. Prepare construction cost estimates.
iii. Prepare and manage construction contracts.
iv. Monitor the performance of contractors.
v. Inspect the quality of buildings and infrastructure being constructed.
Roads Section
i. Identify and plan the construction of new roads.
ii. Prepare cost estimates for road construction.
iii. Manage road construction contracts.
iv. Monitor the quality of roads being built or repaired.
v. Supervise the construction and maintenance of bus stations.
Rural and Urban Development Section
i. Manage the development of rural and urban settlements.
ii. Coordinate urban planning and optimal land use.
iii. Supervise social and environmental services in settlements.
iv. Coordinate the development of areas growing from villages to towns
v. Participate in resolving conflicts.
vi. Participate in resolving land use conflicts.
Services provided by the Division
Division offers various services to citizens and development stakeholders, including:
i. Management of public building construction projects.
ii. Management of council roads construction and maintenance
iii. Preparation of cost estimates for construction projects.
iv. Professional advice on construction and infrastructure matters.
v. Quality inspection of construction projects
vi. Coordination of rural and urban housing development.
vii. Management of infrastructure project contracts.
Opportunities arising from the Department
Through this division, there are various development opportunities in the Hai District Council, including:
i. Employment opportunities in the construction and infrastructure sector.
ii. Investment opportunities in construction projects and housing development.
iii. Improvement of road and public building infrastructure.
iv. Increase in economic activities due to infrastructure development.
v. Collaboration
pages.text_sw:
Divisheni ya Miundombinu, Maendeleo ya Vijijini na Mijini ina jukumu la kusimamia na kutoa
ushauri kuhusu masuala yote yanayohusu maendeleo ya miundombinu katika Halmashauri.
Majukumu yake makuu ni pamoja na:
i.Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu zinazohusu sekta ya ujenzi na
miundombinu.
ii.Kupanga na kuratibu maendeleo ya miundombinu katika Halmashauri.
iii. Kufanya tathmini na kutoa mapendekezo kuhusu madai ya malipo ya wakandarasi.
iv. Kukagua miradi ya ujenzi ili kuhakikisha ubora wa kazi unazingatiwa.
v. Kutoa vyeti vya kukamilika kwa miradi ya ujenzi kwa mujibu wa mikataba.
vi. Kusimamia ujenzi na ukarabati wa barabara kwa kushirikiana na TARURA.
vii. Kusimamia maendeleo ya makazi ya vijijini na mijini.
viii. Kushiriki katika utatuzi wa migogoro ya matumizi ya ardhi.
ix. Kusimamia mchakato wa ukuaji wa miji na maendeleo ya makazi endelevu.
Mgawanyo wa Majukumu
Divisheni hii imegawanyika katika sehemu kuu tatu (3) ambazo zinatekeleza majukumu tofauti,
ambazo ni:
Sehemu cha Ujenzi
i. Kusimamia miradi ya ujenzi wa majengo ya Serikali na miundombinu mingine.
ii.Kuandaa makadirio ya gharama za ujenzi.
iii. Kuandaa na kusimamia mikataba ya ujenzi.
iv. Kufuatilia utendaji wa wakandarasi.
v. Kukagua ubora wa majengo na miundombinu inayojengwa.
Sehemu cha Barabara
i. Kutambua na kupanga ujenzi wa barabara mpya.
ii. Kuandaa makadirio ya gharama za ujenzi wa barabara.
iii. Kusimamia mikataba ya ujenzi wa barabara.
iv. Kufuatilia ubora wa barabara zinazojengwa au kukarabatiwa.
v. Kusimamia ujenzi na matengenezo ya vituo vya mabasi.
Sehemu cha Maendeleo ya Vijijini na Mijini
i.Kusimamia maendeleo ya makazi ya vijijini na mijini.
ii. Kuratibu upangaji wa miji na matumizi bora ya ardhi.
iii. Kusimamia huduma za kijamii na mazingira katika makazi.
iv. Kuratibu maendeleo ya maeneo yanayokua kutoka vijiji hadi kuwa miji.
v. Kushiriki katika kutatua migogoro ya matumizi ya ardhi.
Huduma zinazotolewa na Divisheni
Divisheni ya Miundombinu hutoa huduma mbalimbali kwa wananchi na wadau wa maendeleo
ikiwa ni pamoja na:
i. Usimamizi wa miradi ya ujenzi wa majengo ya umma.
ii. Usimamizi wa ujenzi na matengenezo ya barabara za Halmashauri.
iii. Uandaaji wa makadirio ya gharama za miradi ya ujenzi.
iv. Ushauri wa kitaalam kuhusu masuala ya ujenzi na miundombinu.
v. Ukaguzi wa ubora wa miradi ya ujenzi.
vi. Kuratibu maendeleo ya makazi ya vijijini na mijini.
vii. Kusimamia mikataba ya miradi ya miundombinu.
Fursa zitokanazo na Idara
Kupitia divisheni hii kuna fursa mbalimbali za maendeleo katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Hai,
zikiwemo:
i. Fursa za ajira katika sekta ya ujenzi na miundombinu.
ii. Fursa za uwekezaji katika miradi ya ujenzi na maendeleo ya makazi.
iii. Kuimarika kwa miundombinu ya barabara na majengo ya umma.
iv. Kuongezeka kwa shughuli za kiuchumi kutokana na maendeleo ya miundombinu.
v. Ushirikiano kati ya Halmashauri, sekta binafsi na wadau wa maendeleo katika utekelezaji wa miradi.
Mafanikio
Baadhi ya mafanikio yaliyopatikana kupitia utekelezaji wa majukumu ya divisheni ni pamoja na:
i. Ujenzi na ukarabati wa barabara katika maeneo mbalimbali ya Halmashauri.
ii. Ujenzi na ukarabati wa majengo ya umma kama vile shule, vituo vya afya na ofisi za
Serikali.
iii. Kuimarika kwa usimamizi wa miradi ya maendeleo.
iv. Kuongezeka kwa ubora wa miundombinu ya kijamii na kiuchumi.
v. Kuimarika kwa upangaji na maendeleo ya makazi ya vijijini na mijini.

pages.title: Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries
pages.text_en:
The Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Division is responsible for overseeing the development of the agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and fisheries sectors within the Council. Its main responsibilities include:
i. Interpreting, analyzing, and supervising the implementation of policies, laws, and regulations related to agriculture, livestock, and fisheries.
ii. Proposing standards and prices for goods and services derived from agriculture, livestock, and fisheries activities.
iii. Preparing short-term and long-term plans and programs for the development of agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and fisheries.
iv. Supervising the development and administration of cooperative societies within the Council.
v. Providing professional advice to stakeholders in agriculture, livestock, and fisheries.
vi. Preparing and submitting various development reports for these sectors.
vii. Supervising the collection and control of revenues generated from agriculture, livestock, and fisheries activities.
2. Division of Responsibilities
This division is divided into three (3) sections to facilitate the execution of its duties:
(i) Agriculture Section
This section is responsible for:
Coordinating the distribution of agricultural inputs such as fertilizers and seeds.
Conducting soil testing and providing advice on proper fertilizer use.
Training farmers on improved crop production, post-harvest handling, and value addition.
Collecting data and conducting agricultural censuses.
Coordinating demonstration farms and agricultural trials.
Supervising irrigation projects and establishing water user associations.
Overseeing the development and administration of cooperative societies within the Council.
Implementing various agricultural development programs such as biogas and crop diversification.
(ii) Livestock Section
This section is responsible for:
Supervising the implementation of livestock policies, laws, and regulations.
Preparing short-term and long-term livestock development plans.
Managing the use and conservation of livestock resources.
Providing professional services to livestock keepers.
Coordinating and supervising livestock development projects.
(iii) Fisheries Section
This section is responsible for:
Supervising the implementation of fisheries policies, laws, and regulations.
Preparing plans and programs for the development of fisheries resources.
Managing the conservation and sustainable use of fisheries resources.
Providing professional advice to fishers and stakeholders in the fisheries sector.
Coordinating and supervising fisheries development projects.
3. Services Provided by the Division
The Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Division provides various services to citizens and stakeholders, including:
Professional advice on agriculture, livestock, and fisheries.
Training for farmers, livestock keepers, and fishers on best production practices.
Coordinating access to agricultural and livestock inputs.
Soil testing and guidance on proper fertilizer use.
Management of irrigation and agricultural development projects.
Collection and dissemination of data for agriculture, livestock, and fisheries sectors.
Coordination of the formation and management of cooperative societies.
4. Opportunities from the Division
This division provides various economic and development opportunities for citizens, including:
Employment and business opportunities in agriculture, livestock, and fisheries.
Investment opportunities in crop production, livestock keeping, and aquaculture.
Opportunities for value addition in agricultural and livestock products.
Opportunities to use modern agricultural and irrigation technologies.
Access to loans and grants through development projects in these sectors.
5. Achievements of the Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Division – Hai District
Through the implementation of its responsibilities, Hai District has achieved significant progress in the agriculture, livestock, and fisheries sectors as follows:
1. Strengthening of the Agriculture Sector
Approximately 78% of Hai District’s economy depends on agriculture, and over 80% of its population is engaged in farming.
Major crops grown include maize, bananas, beans, rice, coffee, sunflower, as well as vegetables and fruits.
Maize is the most widely cultivated crop, covering about 22,000 hectares, making Hai one of the leading maize-producing districts in the Kilimanjaro Region.
Achievements include:
Increased production of food and cash crops.
Increased use of improved seeds, fertilizers, and modern farming technologies.
Growth in the cultivation of cash crops such as coffee and vanilla.
2. Expansion of Irrigation Area
The government has invested more than TZS 844,000,000 in the construction and rehabilitation of irrigation canals in Hai District.
This investment has increased irrigated land from 9,666 hectares to 10,266 hectares, contributing to higher crop production.
Achievements:
Increased production of rice, vegetables, and other irrigated crops.
Reduced dependence on rainfall alone for crop production.
3. Strengthening of the Livestock Sector
Livestock keeping is an important part of the agricultural production system in Hai District.
The district has a large number of livestock, including:
Over 132,000 cattle
Over 28,000 sheep
Over 9,000 goats
Achievements:
Increased production of milk and livestock products.
Improved use of manure in farming.
Growth in modern livestock and dairy farming projects.
4. Strengthening of Cooperative Societies
Hai District has a total of 76 cooperative societies engaged in various economic activities, including:
27 agricultural cooperatives
36 SACCOS
13 dairy cooperatives
2 irrigation cooperatives
SACCOS in the district have:
Over 19,400 members
Savings exceeding TZS 8,900,900,000
Achievements:
Increased access to loans for farmers and livestock keepers.
Improved markets for agricultural and livestock products.
5. Value Addition of Agricultural Products
The district has established a vanilla processing center with the capacity to produce 3 tons per season, valued at over TZS 255,000,000–270,000,000 annually.
Achievements:
Increased value of farmers’ produce.
Growth in farmers’ incomes and the district economy.

Divisheni ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi ina jukumu la kusimamia maendeleo ya sekta za kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi katika Halmashauri. Majukumu makuu ni pamoja na: -
i. Kuchambua, kufasiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na kanuni zinazohusu sekta za kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
ii. Kupendekeza viwango na bei za bidhaa na huduma zitokanazo na shughuli za kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
iii. Kuandaa mipango na programu za muda mfupi na muda mrefu kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
iv. Kusimamia uendelezaji na utawala wa vyama vya ushirika ndani ya Halmashauri.
v. Kutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kwa wadau wa sekta za kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
vi. Kuandaa na kuwasilisha taarifa mbalimbali za maendeleo ya sekta hizo.
vii. Kusimamia ukusanyaji na udhibiti wa mapato yanayotokana na shughuli za kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
2. Mgawanyo wa Majukumu
Divisheni hii imegawanyika katika sehemu tatu (3) ili kurahisisha utekelezaji wa majukumu yake:
(i) Sehemu ya Kilimo
Sehemu hii inahusika na:
Kuratibu usambazaji wa pembejeo za kilimo kama mbolea na mbegu.
Kufanya uchunguzi wa udongo na kutoa ushauri wa matumizi sahihi ya mbolea.
Kutoa mafunzo kwa wakulima kuhusu uzalishaji bora wa mazao, utunzaji baada ya mavuno na uongezaji thamani.
Kukusanya takwimu na kufanya sensa za kilimo.
Kuratibu mashamba darasa na majaribio ya kilimo.
Kusimamia miradi ya umwagiliaji na uanzishaji wa vyama vya watumia maji.
Kusimamia uendelezaji na utawala wa vyama vya ushirika ndani ya Halmashauri.
Kutekeleza programu mbalimbali za maendeleo ya kilimo kama vile biogas na mseto wa mazao.
(ii) Sehemu ya Mifugo
Sehemu hii inahusika na:
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na kanuni za sekta ya mifugo.
Kuandaa mipango ya maendeleo ya mifugo ya muda mfupi na muda mrefu.
Kusimamia matumizi na uhifadhi wa rasilimali za mifugo.
Kutoa huduma za kitaalamu kwa wafugaji.
Kuratibu na kusimamia miradi ya maendeleo ya mifugo.
(iii) Sehemu ya Uvuvi
Sehemu hii inahusika na:
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na kanuni za sekta ya uvuvi.
Kuandaa mipango na programu za maendeleo ya rasilimali za uvuvi.
Kusimamia uhifadhi na matumizi endelevu ya rasilimali za uvuvi.
Kutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kwa wavuvi na wadau wa sekta ya uvuvi.
Kuratibu na kusimamia miradi ya maendeleo ya uvuvi.
3. Huduma Zinazotolewa na Divisheni
Divisheni ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi hutoa huduma mbalimbali kwa wananchi na wadau ikiwa ni pamoja na:
Ushauri wa kitaalamu kuhusu kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
Mafunzo kwa wakulima, wafugaji na wavuvi kuhusu mbinu bora za uzalishaji.
Kuratibu upatikanaji wa pembejeo za kilimo na mifugo.
Uchunguzi wa udongo na ushauri wa matumizi sahihi ya mbolea.
Usimamizi wa miradi ya umwagiliaji na maendeleo ya kilimo.
Ukusanyaji na utoaji wa takwimu za sekta za kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
Kuratibu uundaji na usimamizi wa vyama vya ushirika.
4. Fursa Zitokanazo na Divisheni ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi
Divisheni hii inatoa fursa mbalimbali za kiuchumi na maendeleo kwa wananchi, ikiwa ni pamoja na:
Fursa za ajira na biashara katika sekta ya kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
Fursa za uwekezaji katika uzalishaji wa mazao, ufugaji na ufugaji wa samaki.
Fursa za uongezaji thamani wa mazao ya kilimo na mifugo.
Fursa za matumizi ya teknolojia mpya za kilimo na umwagiliaji.
Fursa za mikopo na ruzuku kupitia miradi ya maendeleo ya sekta hizi.
5. Mafanikio ya Divisheni ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi – Wilaya ya Hai
Kupitia utekelezaji wa majukumu ya Divisheni ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi, Wilaya ya Hai imepata mafanikio mbalimbali katika maendeleo ya sekta za kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi kama ifuatavyo:
1. Kuimarika kwa Sekta ya Kilimo
Takribani asilimia 78 ya uchumi wa Wilaya ya Hai unategemea kilimo, na zaidi ya asilimia 80 ya wakazi wake wanajihusisha na kilimo cha mazao mbalimbali.
Mazao makuu yanayolimwa ni mahindi, ndizi, maharage, mpunga, kahawa, alizeti pamoja na mbogamboga na matunda.
Zao la mahindi hulimwa katika eneo kubwa zaidi na kutumiwa na watu wengi kama chakula ukilinganisha na mazao mengine katika Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro ambapo Wilaya ya Hai ni miongoni mwa wilaya zenye eneo kubwa la uzalishaji wa zao hilo, takribani hekta 22,000 hulimwa mahindi.
Mafanikio yaliyopatikana ni pamoja na:
Kuongezeka kwa uzalishaji wa mazao ya chakula na biashara.
Kuongezeka kwa matumizi ya mbegu bora, mbolea na teknolojia za kisasa za kilimo.
Kuimarika kwa kilimo cha mazao ya biashara kama kahawa na vanilla .
2. Kuongezeka kwa Eneo la Umwagiliaji
Serikali imewekeza zaidi ya TZS. 844,000,000.00 kwa ajili ya ujenzi na ukarabati wa mifereji ya umwagiliaji katika Wilaya ya Hai.
Uwekezaji huu umeongeza eneo la umwagiliaji kutoka hekta 9,666 hadi hekta 10,266, hali inayochangia kuongeza uzalishaji wa mazao.
Mafanikio:
Kuongezeka kwa uzalishaji wa mazao ya mpunga, mboga mboga na mazao mengine yanayolimwa kwa umwagiliaji.
Kupungua kwa utegemezi wa mvua pekee katika uzalishaji wa mazao.
3. Kuimarika kwa Sekta ya Mifugo
Ufugaji ni sehemu muhimu ya mfumo wa uzalishaji wa kilimo katika Wilaya ya Hai.
Wilaya ina idadi kubwa ya mifugo ikiwemo:
Ng’ombe zaidi ya 132,000
Kondoo zaidi ya 28,000
Mbuzi zaidi ya 9,000
Mafanikio yaliyopatikana:
Kuongezeka kwa uzalishaji wa maziwa na bidhaa za mifugo.
Kuimarika kwa matumizi ya mbolea ya samadi katika mashamba ya wakulima.
Kuongezeka kwa miradi ya ufugaji wa kisasa na ufugaji wa maziwa.
4. Kuimarika kwa Vyama vya Ushirika
Wilaya ya Hai ina jumla ya vyama vya ushirika 76 vinavyojihusisha na shughuli mbalimbali za kiuchumi.
Miongoni mwa vyama hivyo:
27 vyama vya ushirika wa mazao
36 SACCOS
13 vyama vya maziwa
2 vyama vya umwagiliaji
SACCOS katika wilaya vina:
Wanachama zaidi ya 19,400
Akiba ya zaidi ya TZS. 8,900,900,000 . 00
Mafanikio:
Kuongezeka kwa upatikanaji wa mikopo kwa wakulima na wafugaji.
Kuimarika kwa masoko ya mazao na bidhaa za mifugo.
5. Uongezaji Thamani wa Mazao
Wilaya imeanzisha kituo cha kusindika vanilla chenye uwezo wa kuzalisha tani 3 kwa msimu, chenye thamani ya zaidi ya TZS. 255,000,000.00 – 270,000,000.00 kwa mwaka.
Mafanikio:
Kuongezeka kwa thamani ya mazao ya wakulima.
Kuongezeka kwa kipato cha wakulima na uchumi wa wilaya.

pages.title: Industry, Trade and Investment
pages.text_en:
DIVISION OF INDUSTRY, TRADE, AND INVESTMENT
Objective:
To provide a conducive business environment for the development of industries, markets, and investment.
Responsibilities:
This Division carries out the following responsibilities:
Coordinating the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to industry, trade, markets, and investment.
Promoting industries, trade, markets, and investment within the council.
Planning and establishing industrial areas and reserves in collaboration with other key stakeholders.
Developing strategies to enhance industries, trade, markets, and investment.
Promoting the growth of small and medium enterprises (SMEs).
Preparing investment proposals and projects.
Facilitating private sector development.
Establishing and managing a database for industries, trade, markets, and investment.
Managing the one-stop business center.
Conducting studies to promote investment.
Coordinating trade platforms.
Managing markets and auction activities within the council.
Implementing the Business Growth Strategy for small traders and microservice providers.
Providing a conducive environment for business and investment to stimulate trade and investment.
The Division is headed by the Division Manager and is divided into two sections as follows:
Industry and Investment Development Section
Trade and Markets Section
Industry and Investment Development Section
This section performs the following activities:
Coordinating the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to industry and investment sectors.
Promoting and coordinating public-private sector partnerships.
Allocating, establishing, and monitoring industrial areas and reserves.
Advising on policy improvements for industries and coordinating sectoral meetings.
Promoting the production of raw materials for industrial use.
Preparing and maintaining industry and investment registers.
Planning and estimating taxes for small industries.
Promoting private sector investment.
Developing and reviewing investment profiles.
Coordinating and advising investors.
Creating a conducive environment for investment.
This section is led by the responsible officer.
Trade and Markets Section
This section performs the following activities:
Managing the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to trade and markets.
Providing entrepreneurship skills to business communities.
Coordinating and advising on business registration activities.
Analyzing trade and market information and providing relevant advice.
Coordinating the Council’s trade platform.
Promoting public-private sector partnerships.
Managing markets and auction activities within the council.
Collecting and disseminating market information on goods and services to interested stakeholders.
Implementing the Business Development Strategy for small traders and microservice providers.
Providing a conducive business environment.
